reason: This PR touches the core row-write/table layer APIs (`Table.AddRecord`, `Table.UpdateRecord`, `IndexCreate`) plus executor write paths, with changes spread across table, index, cache, and partition implementations. Even if framed as a refactor, this is central mutation-path code where option handling mistakes can cause correctness regressions, index inconsistency, or partition/cache-specific write bugs. The blast radius is high enough to justify a focused deep review for Blocker/High issues.
